# Inputs

Reusable form controls and text inputs.

## Usage
Include the CSS:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="path/to/components/inputs/input.css">
```

Example HTML:
```html
<div class="t-input-group">
  <label class="t-label" for="email">Email Address</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" class="t-input" placeholder="Enter your email">
</div>

<div class="t-input-group">
  <label class="t-label" for="username">Username (Glass)</label>
  <input type="text" id="username" class="t-input t-input-glass" placeholder="Choose a username">
</div>
```
